catalogue_rules.description: Models /local shows beyond the scored cohort, so the page can answer 'what could my machine run' and not only 'which ranked models fit'. They carry a size and a Hugging Face link and nothing else: no composite, no rank, no score. The rule below is mechanical and reads no publisher; every threshold is debatable by pull request.
catalogue_rules.note: Repos that only re-pack another model (quantised formats), base checkpoints that were never instruction-tuned, OCR-only readers and community 'uncensored' edits are left out by name pattern: a whole word of the repo name must equal a token, or end with a suffix, listed here. Order is Hugging Face downloads, which measures popularity and not quality; the page says so.
